constraints.noteOnLinks: every href must be same-site per the no-outbound-links constraint (localHref/isInternal in src/components/ui.jsx:8-11,23)

responsive.phone: Hamburger/mobile-menu trigger is shown (bare default); desktop nav links are not rendered at all in the DOM at this width.
responsive.tablet: Desktop-style inline nav links become visible (tablet:flex) and the mobile hamburger trigger is hidden (tablet:hidden) -- the breakpoint switch happens at the tablet boundary, not a separate desktop-only rule.
responsive.desktop: Same as tablet -- no further navbar-specific rule beyond the tablet:flex / tablet:hidden switch (desktop inherits tablet's nav layout).
